title: 第十四章 执掌中馈权，暗流仍未歇
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

翌日晨光破晓，整座京城还沉浸在昨日海棠宴的风波余震里，丞相府已然悄然换了新局。

往日里晨昏时分必去各处院落巡查、调度府中琐事的柳氏，今日彻底没了动静。凝香院院门落锁，内外下人尽数被调换，只剩几个粗使婆子看守，冷冷清清，再无半分往日鼎盛热闹的模样。

府里大小管事、仆婢全都心知肚明，柳姨娘彻底失势，往后相府的天，是嫡小姐沈清鸢的。

清晨时分，老夫人便传了话，将相府所有账本、库房钥匙、中馈对牌，尽数移交至沈清鸢手中。

正堂之内，一众管事先后垂首立着，不敢有半分懈怠。从前他们大多看柳氏脸色行事，对汀兰院多有敷衍克扣，如今亲眼见证沈清鸢步步破局、扳倒柳氏、撼动东宫，个个心底敬畏万分。

老夫人坐在主位，神色肃穆：“从今往后，府中大小事务，皆由清鸢做主调度，所有人谨遵嫡小姐吩咐，若有偷懒懈怠、阳奉阴违者，直接发卖赶出相府，绝不姑息。”

一众管事齐齐躬身应声：“谨遵老夫人、大小姐吩咐！”

沈清鸢伸手接过沉甸甸的紫檀木对牌与厚厚一摞账本，指尖微凉。这执掌后宅的权力，本该是她生母的，却被柳氏窃占多年，借着管家之名，大肆侵吞生母嫁妆、克扣汀兰院用度，积攒私产。

今日她亲手拿回，不过是物归原主。

送走一众管事，老夫人拉过她的手，语气温和：“鸢儿，祖母知道你聪慧沉稳，打理家事定然稳妥。若是遇上棘手账目、难缠下人，尽管告诉祖母，祖母替你撑腰。”

“孙女儿晓得，劳祖母费心。”沈清鸢浅浅屈膝，眉眼温顺。

回到汀兰院，春桃捧着账本欢喜不已：“小姐！咱们终于掌家了！往后再也没人敢苛待咱们院子，柳姨娘和二小姐再也拿捏不到咱们分毫！”

沈清鸢翻开泛黄的旧账本，指尖划过密密麻麻的字迹，眼底却无半分欣喜，只剩微凉寒意。

账本看似规整周全，实则处处暗藏猫腻。近几年府中采买、田地收益、铺面分红，总有大半银两莫名流失，尽数流入柳氏私囊，其中不少，都是生母当年留下的产业进项。

“风光只是一时。”沈清鸢轻声开口，“柳氏野心盘踞相府十几年，根基颇深，手里定然还藏着不少私产底牌，绝不会甘心就此落败。还有东宫那位，储位动摇，心中积恨，只会伺机反扑，咱们眼下，半点不能松懈。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

As dawn broke the next day, the whole capital was still immersed in the aftershocks of yesterday's Begonia Banquet, and the Prime Minister's Mansion had quietly changed its situation.

Mrs. Liu, who used to go to various courtyards in the morning and dusk to inspect and coordinate the chores in the house, was completely silent today.The gate of Ningxiang Courtyard was locked, and all the servants inside and outside were replaced. Only a few rough envoys and women were left to guard it.

All the stewards and servants in the mansion knew very well that Aunt Liu had completely lost her power. From now on, the throne of the prime minister's mansion belonged to the legitimate daughter Shen Qingyuan.

In the early morning, the old lady sent a message to hand over all the account books, warehouse keys, and cards in the Prime Minister's Mansion to Shen Qingyuan.

In the main hall, all the stewards stood with their heads lowered one after another, not daring to slack off in the slightest.In the past, most of them acted based on the Liu family's face, and they were often perfunctory and submissive to Tinglan Courtyard. Now, they are all in awe as they witness Shen Qingyuan breaking through the situation step by step, overthrowing the Liu family, and shaking up the East Palace.

The old lady sat in the main seat with a solemn expression: "From now on, all matters in the mansion will be controlled by Qing Yuan. Everyone will obey the instructions of the concubine. If anyone is lazy or violates the rules, they will be directly sold out and kicked out of the prime minister's mansion. We will not tolerate it."

All the stewards bowed and responded: "I obey the instructions of the old lady and the eldest lady!"

Shen Qingyuan reached out and took over the heavy rosewood pair of cards and a thick stack of ledgers, her fingertips feeling slightly cold.The power to control the back house should have belonged to her biological mother, but it had been stolen by the Liu family for many years. In the name of the housekeeper, she embezzled her biological mother's dowry, deducted the expenses of Tinglan Courtyard, and accumulated private property.

Today she took it back with her own hands, but it was returned to its original owner.

After seeing off all the stewards, the old lady took her hand and said in a gentle tone: "Yuan'er, grandma knows that you are smart and steady, and you will be able to take care of the house. If you encounter difficult accounts or servants, just tell grandma and she will support you."

"My granddaughter knows, I'm sorry for bothering grandma." Shen Qingyuan bowed her knees slightly, her eyebrows gentle.

Returning to Tinglan Courtyard, Chuntao was overjoyed while holding the account book: "Miss! We are finally in charge of the family! From now on, no one will dare to treat our courtyard harshly, and Aunt Liu and the second lady will never be able to control us at all!"

Shen Qingyuan opened the yellowed old account book, and his fingertips ran across the dense handwriting, but there was no joy in his eyes, only a slight chill.

The ledger seems to be neat and tidy, but in fact there are hidden tricks everywhere.In recent years, most of the money from Fuzhong purchases, land income, and shop dividends has been lost inexplicably, and all of it has gone into Liu's private pocket. Many of them are the property income left by the biological mother.

"The glory is only temporary." Shen Qingyuan spoke softly, "The Liu family's ambition has been entrenched in the Prime Minister's Palace for more than ten years. It has a deep foundation. It must still have many private assets hidden in its hands. It will never be willing to lose. There is also the man in the East Palace. His position is shaken and he has hatred in his heart. He will only wait for opportunities to counterattack. We cannot relax at the moment."
